summary: fetch-runtime ships as a name-mismatched copy of lines-and-columns with unused opaque string constants
details: Package `fetch-runtime@1.4.0` is described as a fetch client, but the shipped source and README are copied from the unrelated `lines-and-columns` package. The module exports two opaque, non-decoded string constants named `userAgent` and `fetchEngine` (e.g. `var userAgent = "y0aItEWGzU5WTQfpTqcl985/ZB9e..."`) that are never referenced by any code path. The module also references an undefined `markers` identifier via `exports.markers = markers;`, which throws ReferenceError on `require()`, so the module is not loadable as-shipped. There are no lifecycle scripts, no network I/O, no exec/eval, no filesystem access, and no credential access in the traced code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
